Subject: Internal: BrightSet — one-time starter concession request (summary + ask)

Team — quick summary and request for sign-off path. BrightSet (prospect -> pilot) is asking for a time-limited deep starter discount so they can pilot across 3 EU regions on Dedicated + VPC. Key commercial points: 

- Proposed commercial structure we negotiated with the customer: 
  • Pilot length: 6 months (2-month initial + 4-month ramp)
  • Committed floor: EUR 75k/month starting month 1, with planned ramp to EUR 200k/month by month 4
  • Packaging: Dedicated GPU pool + Private VPC (ops premium typically +15%)
  • Customer requested starter discount: 35–40% off standard list for months 1–3; then revert to standard committed tier pricing
  • Payment terms requested: net 45 for pilot months

- Why this matters: BrightSet is a high-signal bio partner in the EU and likely to convert to a multi-year committed account post-pilot. We expect 12–18 month upsell potential to Dedicated fleet and Optimize add-ons.

- Trade-offs / unit economics (see attached Deal_Econ_BrightSet_Q4.xlsx): 
  • At 40% starter discount capped to first 3 months, margin after ops premium is ~12% versus our target ~25% — acceptable only as a short-term sales acceleration.
  • If we absorb the ops premium (i.e., no +15% on Dedicated), incremental margin drops further; recommend we avoid absorbing full premium.

Ask: I need VP/CFO authorization to offer a capped starter concession structured as: 
  1) 38% discount off list for months 1–3 capped at EUR 225k total concession value;
  2) Dedicated ops premium remains +10% (we reduce from standard +15% to split the concession);
  3) Commitment clause: customer signs a 6-month MSA+SOW with plan to convert to a 12-month committed rate by month 6 subject to usage thresholds;
  4) One-time make-good: if conversion does not occur, no retro credits but we reserve right to decline future starter concessions.

Can Karthik/Marissa/Kimberly confirm approval or provide changes by COB Friday (Oct 6) so I can respond to BrightSet and get DocuSign moving?

Thanks — Sofia

Attachments: Deal_Econ_BrightSet_Q4.xlsx

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 06 Oct 2028 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: BrightSet — one-time starter concession request (summary + ask)

Sofia — reviewed the econ sheet and did a quick sensitivity. My read:

- The proposed 38% starter discount capped to months 1–3 with a EUR 225k concession cap is reasonable as a short-term activation lever provided we lock the conversion milestone.
- Recommend we: 
  1) Add a minimum activation clause: if usage < 70% of committed floor for first two billing cycles, concession triggers clawback as credit in month 4.
  2) Keep Dedicated ops premium at +10% as you proposed — we should not absorb the full premium.
  3) Approve net-45 for pilot months only; post-conversion revert to standard net-30.

Risk: if customer delays conversion and we maintain the reduced premium for >3 months, we erode the account-level LTV. The clawback + conversion milestone should mitigate this.

I’m comfortable recommending this to the VP/CFO with those two protective clauses added.

-Markus
VP, Sales Operations

(On a separate note — we should track pilot health via Redwood Console run-rate dashboard; I can add a custom monitor.)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Internal: BrightSet — one-time starter concession request (summary + ask)

Thanks for the write-up and the econ model. I reviewed the proposed structure and the added protective clauses from Markus. Decision: APPROVE with minor edits.

Approved commercial authorization (finalized terms):
- Starter concession: 36% discount off list for months 1–3, capped at EUR 200k concession value (reduced from proposed 225k).
- Dedicated ops premium: +10% (we will not absorb further).
- Clawback: activation threshold set at 70% of committed floor over first two billing cycles; failure to meet threshold triggers pro-rated credit in month 4.
- Payment terms: net-45 for pilot months; revert to net-30 upon conversion.
- Approval conditions: Customer must sign MSA + SOW and provide PO by Oct 17, 2028.

Kimberly — please prepare a one-off approval memo for records and confirm accounting codes for concession tracking. Marissa — please proceed to finalize the DocuSign SOW with the updated concession cap and get the customer to sign.

Karthik Iyer
SVP Finance (acting CFO) | Redwood Inference
